authorityChain: Product documents / BJ / UC / decisions / behavioral and UI contracts
verificationNote: Version/date re-verified from live Figma Overview on 2026-09-09. Inventory counts are retained from the preceding lock until a full asset census is rerun.
componentSelectionPriority: 1. Matching canonical V* component when it satisfies the exact responsibility without semantic distortion
2. Matching existing canonical non-V Figma component when no suitable V* component exists
3. Existing Figma pattern/template for structural or interaction responsibility
4. Ordinary layout composition of existing DS assets without creating a named Theme/Product component
5. New component only after a proven reusable responsibility gap; a screen-specific grouping is not gap proof
componentSelectionGuard: V prefix is a priority among semantically valid candidates. Before creating any new component, prove that no existing V-component, non-V component, pattern/template, or ordinary composition of existing DS assets can express the responsibility.

VBottomSheet.note: BJ01 must use the VBottomSheet shell directly; do not retain a custom Theme7 sheet shell.

BJ01Availability.note: Theme7AvailabilitySummary removed; primary and supporting quantity outcomes reuse Key-value Row. Layout wrapper is not a component.

VBannerHeight.note: Product HTML must not force a 96px minimum height. Default and brief banner content hug the rendered copy while preserving canonical padding, gap, border, radius, icon size and semantic tone.
